title: IT494 Raw Corpora
subtitle: 69 public-domain books, 100 CC-BY papers, 19,206 LongMemEval sessions
description:
Raw inputs for the IT 494 memory-backend project, byte-identical to what each source served. Nothing is cleaned or split; the only processing is unpacking two benchmark JSON files into one file per document, by the scripts in the project repository.

**Folders**

- `oz/` (29), `holmes/` (9), `greek/` (31): Project Gutenberg texts, plus six Archive.org institutional scans in greek/. Public domain in the United States by expiry of term.
- `graphrag-bench/` (20): the novel contexts of GraphRAG-Bench (ICLR 2026), one text file each, unpacked from novel.json. MIT, copyright the GraphRAG-Bench authors; LICENSE included. https://github.com/GraphRAG-Bench/GraphRAG-Benchmark
- `kg-rag-cc/` (100): full-text papers on knowledge graphs and retrieval-augmented generation, gathered from OpenAlex, PDFs under `pdf/`. Every one is Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), recorded per paper rather than assumed. Its `manifest.json` carries the title, authors, year, venue, DOI, OpenAlex id, exact license and source URL of each paper: **CC-BY requires attribution, so render authors, title and license from that manifest wherever a paper is shown or quoted.**
- `longmemeval/` (19,206): every distinct non-empty session of LongMemEval-S (ICLR 2025), one JSON file each with session_id, dates, and turns as role and content. MIT, copyright 2024 Di Wu; LICENSE included. https://github.com/xiaowu0162/LongMemEval

Each folder carries a `manifest.json` with bytes and sha256 per file. `SOURCES.md` records where every file came from and why it is here; `USAGE.md` records what each corpus is for.

Version 3 (2026-09-09) adds `kg-rag-cc/`. Version 2 (2026-09-04) added the two benchmark folders and removed `chinese/` and the Statius Thebaid; version 1 keeps both.

**Licensing is layered, so the dataset label is 'other'.** The packaging, the manifests and every derived field are MIT. The literature is public domain in the United States by expiry of term. The two benchmark folders keep their own MIT notices. The papers in `kg-rag-cc/` are CC-BY and may be redistributed with attribution, which their manifest supplies. No file here is offered under a license its source did not grant.
